ei.title: Arles, the City of Light and Art

fullPassage:
Arles, the City of Light and Art

Certain artists are so closely linked with particular places that it is hard to separate them. Arles and Van Gogh are like that. Arles is located five hours southeast of Paris and is well known for its magical light and colorful landscape. The most famous resident of this town was Vincent van Gogh. Leaving behind the gray skies of Paris, he arrived in Arles in 1888.

The town inspired an explosion of creativity. Vincent claimed, "The whole future of art is to be found in the south of France." He worked enthusiastically and produced nearly 200 paintings in just fifteen months. None of Vincent's works are left in Arles now, but today you can see a number of them have been recreated in street-side panels. Let's follow Vincent's traces that remain in Arles.

The Roman Arena

Arles is an ancient city dating back to Roman times. Many Roman buildings remain, including an arena that was built in 90 A.D. The arena used to seat over 20,000 people who would go to watch various entertaining events.

Vincent sometimes went to the bullfights that were held in the arena every Sunday. He particularly liked to watch the colorful crowds. He told a friend that he found the crowds fascinating. They inspired the painting Arena at Arles. The arena is in the top right corner of the painting and is barely visible. Below, there is a faint image of two bulls. However, Vincent paid lots of attention to the people and their colorful clothes. Some of the people are chatting with friends, others are cheering on the bulls, and the entire painting has a powerful energy.

Café van Gogh

Vincent painted the world-famous Café Terrace at Night in September 1888. He created this work while sitting outside the Café van Gogh at night. This was unusual because most painters did their night scenes from memory and worked during the daytime. As such, they used a lot of black paint. Vincent, however, believed that night scenes contained diverse and vibrant colors. Indeed, the Café Terrace at Night has such a rich harmony of yellows, blues, and oranges that Vincent did not have to use a single drop of black paint.

Even today, there is still a café at the site of Vincent's painting. It was renovated in the 1990s and painted yellow to look like the café in the painting. However, it is uncertain whether the color of the original café was yellow or not. The reason is that Vincent painted the wall of the café yellow to show the lamp light.

Former Arles Hospital

In December 1888, Vincent suffered from a mental illness and was sent to the hospital in Arles. He stayed there for five months. During this time, his mental stability improved, and the doctors allowed him to paint outdoors. Vincent took advantage of this freedom and produced several beautiful landscapes, such as The Garden of the Hospital in Arles. The picture illustrates a spring garden filled with flowers and trees with different colors and tones. The flowers are in full bloom, and the small trees are leafy. The big trees, however, have few leaves. This is rather odd given that the season is spring. Perhaps this contrast reflects the painter's complex feelings during the most difficult time of his life.

The hospital closed in the 1980s, and the building reopened as a library and exhibition space, with a café and gift shops. The garden was renovated to resemble Vincent's painting as much as possible.

Arles and its provincial countryside inspired Vincent to create brighter, more exciting landscapes. He had searched for brighter colors and softer light in Paris. In Arles, he found them. Today, more than 100 years later, this beautiful city remains just as attractive. The combination of Roman historic sites and Vincent's story creates a unique mood that will inspire you just as the city had inspired Vincent.

questions.passage: Certain artists are so closely linked with particular places that it is hard to separate them. Arles and Van Gogh are like that. Arles is located five hours southeast of Paris and is well known for its (A)[magical / ordinary] light and colorful landscape. The most famous resident of this town was Vincent van Gogh. Leaving behind the gray skies of Paris, he arrived in Arles in 1888. The town inspired an (B)[explosion / decline] of creativity. Vincent claimed, "The whole future of art is to be found in the south of France." He worked (C)[enthusiastically / reluctantly] and produced nearly 200 paintings in just fifteen months.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 아를은 마법 같은 빛과 다채로운 풍경으로 잘 알려져 있다. 마을은 창의력의 폭발을 영감 주었다. 빈센트는 열정적으로 작업하여 불과 15개월 만에 거의 200점을 그렸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① magical — explosion — enthusiastically
❌ ② ordinary — explosion — reluctantly
❌ ③ magical — decline — reluctantly
❌ ④ ordinary — decline — enthusiastically
✅ (A) magical: '마법 같은' 빛. ordinary(평범한)는 아를의 특별한 빛과 반대. ✅ (B) explosion: '폭발'. decline(감소)은 200점 작품 생산과 반대. ✅ (C) enthusiastically: '열정적으로'. reluctantly(마지못해)는 200점 생산 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: explosion of creativity = '창의력의 폭발'. enthusiastically = '열정적으로' (enthusiasm의 부사형).

questions.passage: Vincent sometimes went to the bullfights that were held in the arena every Sunday. He particularly liked to watch the colorful crowds. He told a friend that he found the crowds (A)[fascinating / boring]. They inspired the painting Arena at Arles. The arena is in the top right corner of the painting and is barely (B)[visible / hidden]. Below, there is a (C)[faint / bold] image of two bulls. However, Vincent paid lots of attention to the people and their colorful clothes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 빈센트는 군중이 매혹적이라고 했다. 경기장은 그림 오른쪽 상단에 겨우 보일 정도이다. 아래에 두 마리 황소의 희미한 이미지가 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① boring — visible — faint
❌ ② fascinating — hidden — bold
❌ ③ boring — hidden — faint
✅ ④ fascinating — visible — faint
✅ (A) fascinating: 군중에 영감받아 그림을 그렸으므로 '매혹적인'. boring(지루한)은 영감과 반대. ✅ (B) visible: 'barely visible'은 '겨우 보이는'. hidden(숨겨진)은 barely와 어울리지 않음. ✅ (C) faint: '희미한' 이미지. bold(굵은/뚜렷한)는 barely visible과 같은 맥락에서 부적절.
det.tip: barely visible = '겨우 보이는'. fascinating = '매혹적인' (fascinate의 형용사). faint = '희미한'.

questions.passage: Vincent painted the world-famous Café Terrace at Night in September 1888. This was unusual because most painters did their night scenes from memory and worked during the daytime. As such, they used a lot of black paint. Vincent, however, believed that night scenes contained (A)[diverse / uniform] and vibrant colors. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 빈센트는 야경이 다양하고 생생한 색을 담고 있다고 믿었다. 카페 테라스는 노랑, 파랑, 주황의 풍부한 조화를 이루어 검은색 물감 한 방울도 쓰지 않았다. 카페는 1990년대에 보수되어 노란색으로 칠해졌다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① uniform — harmony — renovated
❌ ② diverse — conflict — abandoned
✅ ③ diverse — harmony — renovated
❌ ④ uniform — conflict — abandoned
✅ (A) diverse: '다양한'. uniform(획일적인)은 vibrant colors와 반대. ✅ (B) harmony: '조화'. conflict(갈등)은 색의 조화로운 어울림 맥락에 부적절. ✅ (C) renovated: '보수된'. abandoned(버려진)은 노란색으로 칠한 맥락에 부적절.
det.tip: diverse(다양한) ↔ uniform(획일적인). harmony(조화) ↔ conflict(갈등). renovate = '보수하다'.

(A)     (B)

det.korean: (A) remain = '남아 있다' (자동사, 존재의 의미). (B) remains attractive = '매력적인 채로 있다' (연결동사 + 형용사 보어).
det.analysis: ✅ ③ (A) '남아 있다': 로마 건물들이 존재한다. (B) '~인 채로 있다': remains + attractive 형용사 보어 구조. ❌ ① 둘 다 '남아 있다': (B)는 보어가 있어 '~인 채로' 의미. ❌ ② 순서 반대. ❌ ④ 둘 다 '~인 채로': (A)는 보어 없이 자동사.
det.tip: remain + 존재: '남아 있다'. remain + 형용사 보어: '~인 채로 있다' (연결동사).

다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to bring back into existence or to make again"

det.korean: '다시 존재하게 하다, 다시 만들다' → recreate
det.analysis: ✅ ④ recreate: 're(다시) + create(만들다)' = 영영풀이와 정확히 일치. ❌ ① illustrate: '묘사하다/설명하다'. ❌ ② renovate: '보수하다' — 새로 만드는 것이 아니라 고치는 것. ❌ ③ resemble: '닮다'.
det.tip: recreate = re(다시) + create(만들다) = '재현하다'. renovate = re + novate(새롭게) = '보수하다'.

questions.passage:
The town inspired an explosion of __________. (create)

Vincent claimed, "The whole future of art is to be found in the south of France." He worked enthusiastically and produced nearly 200 paintings in just fifteen months.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: create → creativity(명사): 전치사 of 뒤에 명사 필요. '창의력의 폭발'.
det.analysis:
정답: creativity
of 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하므로 create(동사)를 creativity(명사)로 변환.
det.tip: create(동사) → creativity(명사) → creative(형용사). 전치사(of) + 명사 구조.

questions.passage:
Arles and its provincial countryside inspired Vincent to create brighter, more exciting landscapes. He had searched for brighter colors and softer light in Paris. In Arles, he found them. Today, more than 100 years later, this beautiful city remains just as __________. (attract)

The combination of Roman historic sites and Vincent's story creates a unique mood that will inspire you just as the city had inspired Vincent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: attract → attractive(형용사): remains(연결동사) 뒤 보어 자리에 형용사 필요. '매력적인 채로 남아 있다'.
det.analysis:
정답: attractive
remains는 연결동사로 뒤에 형용사 보어가 필요. attract(동사)를 attractive(형용사)로 변환.
det.tip: attract(동사) → attractive(형용사) → attraction(명사). 연결동사(remain) + 형용사 보어 구조.

questions.passage:
Arles is an ancient city dating back to Roman times. Many Roman buildings remain, including an arena that was built in 90 A.D. The arena used to seat over 20,000 people who would go to watch various entertaining events.

Vincent sometimes went to the bullfights that were held in the arena every Sunday. He particularly liked to watch the colorful crowds. He told a friend that he found the crowds fascinating. They inspired the painting Arena at Arles. The arena is in the top right corner of the painting and is barely visible. Below, there is a faint image of two bulls. However, Vincent __________ to the people and their colorful clothes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈센트는 경기장과 황소는 희미하게 그렸지만, 사람들과 옷에는 많은 관심을 기울였다. However가 단서.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ paid lots of attention: '많은 관심을 기울였다' — However 뒤에 경기장/황소와 대조되는 사람에 대한 관심. ❌ ① paid no regard: '관심을 두지 않았다' — However 대조와 반대. ❌ ② turned a blind eye: '외면했다' — 반대. ❌ ④ showed little interest: '거의 관심을 보이지 않았다' — 반대.
det.tip: pay attention to = '~에 주의를 기울이다'. However가 앞(경기장 희미)과 뒤(사람 강조)의 대조 단서.

questions.passage: In December 1888, Vincent suffered from a mental illness and was sent to the hospital in Arles. He stayed there for five months. During this time, his mental stability improved, and the doctors allowed him to paint outdoors. Vincent __________ and produced several beautiful landscapes, such as The Garden of the Hospital in Arles. The picture illustrates a spring garden filled with flowers and trees with different colors and tones.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의사가 야외 그림을 허락했고, 빈센트는 이 자유를 이용하여 아름다운 풍경화를 여러 점 제작했다. 허락 → 활용 → 작품의 논리 흐름.
det.analysis: ✅ ② took advantage of this freedom: '이 자유를 이용했다' — 의사 허락 → 기회 활용 → 작품 제작의 논리적 흐름. ❌ ① gave up this opportunity: '기회를 포기했다' — 작품 제작과 모순. ❌ ③ was indifferent to this chance: '기회에 무관심했다' — 모순. ❌ ④ lost interest in this privilege: '특권에 흥미를 잃었다' — 모순.
det.tip: take advantage of = '~을 이용하다'. 문맥: 허락(allowed) → 활용(took advantage) → 결과(produced).
